description.value: Oak Bay Beach Hotel is an elegant luxury boutique resort nestled on the shores of Vancouver Island in Victoria, BC, with spacious oceanfront guest rooms overlooking the Salish Sea. Rated the #1 Hotel in Western Canada by Condé Nast Traveller, it blends old-world charm with contemporary service. Touring cyclists finishing a coastal route would find upscale dining, a spa with mineral pools, and multiple on-site restaurants including FARO and The Snug.
